order.why: lowest level of the residential model; its estimates give the dwelling inclusive value IV_A of the county model
middle level; its estimates give the zone x structure-type inclusive value IV_B of the county model
upper level; reads IV_A and IV_B as data columns, so the lower levels come first (the data already hold the inclusive values of the published lower-level models)
independent; smallest school model (141 zones), quickest test of the location-mixture likelihood
independent; largest expression (4 home slots x 1,144 zones), run last

notes: Models 04 to 08 do not depend on each other or on 01 to 03; any order works.

If you re-estimate 03 or 02 and want the county model on your own inclusive values, rebuild them with 01_residential_county/input/code/r07_county_iv.py (needs your lower-level estimates in the r06/r08 CSV format) before running 01.
